body:
The isolated public HydrAMP adapter is implemented and its installed controlled proof is complete.

Public boundary: `HydrAMPBundle`, `HydrAMPLimits`, `generate_hydramp` -> existing `HydrAMPReceipt`. One explicit installed CPU interpreter runs the unchanged provider's unfiltered AMP route (properties=True, one attempt, explicit seed). Source/version/import-origin and checkpoint/PCA hashes are checked before learned operations. Native sampling/PCA/decoding/original-token heads/descriptors remain in HydrAMP; there is no new molecular parser, chemistry, precision, selector or fallback.

The parent supervises time, sampled process-tree RSS, output and host resource floors. The child applies CPU/thread/nice/address-space controls before scientific imports. Owned-group cleanup and parent-death handling have model-free process tests. Structured state distinguishes confirmed operations, failure and unavailable output. Optional Ackredit capture occurs in the application's **parent** session, reusing the existing capture implementation and preserving offline references on attribution failure; replay creates no new credit.

Final local unpublished consumer wheel:
`peptidemt-0.1.0+118.g1f8c444.dirty-py3-none-any.whl`
SHA-256 `18b1cb18b9662092203aad9c64d45bc0d61a862577297c13a664572dbdbc3e83`.
Earlier local wheels are retained in their own directories; no public coordinate is overwritten.

**55 installed controlled tests pass**, including a full foreign-process API call using explicitly artificial provider packages, existing receipt/attribution compatibility and the complete diagnostic catalog. Published Pytest Receptor 1.1.0 agrees with native JUnit. Two separate model-free approval/budget controls pass with published Receptor 1.2.2. An actual absent-engine CLI round trip reports RequiredDependencyError, zero native attempts and no scientific attribution. Both installed prefixes pass pip check; all 26 wheel members except RECORD and all 22 Python files match the exact candidate. Final HTML with warnings fatal and six memory-input doctests pass. These are controlled/transport proofs, **not a real-checkpoint adapter gate**.

The new generation overlay initially inherited shared-base packages because Python venv creation from another venv does not inherit that venv's site-packages. Prefix/path inspection diagnosed this before scientific imports; only the new prefix was corrected. It now excludes shared site-packages, explicitly reuses the unchanged frozen dev3 runtime and adds exact API-only copies of published DepDigest 0.15.1/SMonitor 0.22.0. Corrected pip check passes. No sibling or original scientific environment was modified to fix that audit.

A real reuse need is reported separately in our fork: https://github.com/uibcdf/hydramp/issues/2 — provider-owned descriptive generation/descriptor metadata, so consumers need not maintain another parameter table. This is a nonblocking proposal; dev3 definitions and calculations are unchanged. The expected Ackredit deduplication and the test's wrong DepDigest internal reference were test corrections, not demonstrated provider bugs.

Prepared **single real installed-adapter case**, fresh approval pending:
`local_data/hydramp-execution-adapter-vceg9u_2/live-plan.json`
SHA-256 `1d4679f27d06d95bd402b1f9239e8dc1fc5120a722da5057be526220985da665`.
345 file pins and both interpreter/runtime inventories pass model-free preflight.

Requested maximum: one generation of 16 proposals, seed 1001; one checkpoint load, one numeric PCA load/inverse, one decoder + one AMP + one MIC forward (**three neural forwards**), one descriptor bundle. Reuse the old H4 native receipt for same-provider receiving/trace/replay comparison and verify real parent attribution. **No Macrel, legacy, training, GPU, network or retries.**

Limits: CPU 0/1, one numerical thread, nice 10; worker 180 s, whole case 210 s; 4 GB task RAM intent, sampled aggregate tree RSS stop 2 GiB; virtual address space 8 GiB worker/1 GiB parent; host available RAM floor 8 GiB, disk floor 1 GiB, output 128 MiB. The snapshot shows about 14.65 GiB available RAM and 2.30 TiB free disk; guards recheck actual conditions. Same selected original epoch-37/numeric-PCA bundle and local research/use conditions; unchanged dev3 wheel `81761e0d48d92f0956e0afc28b3b4154f16032de53c666fd2cfbb53606102ed7`.

Local maintained record: `devguide/hydramp_execution_adapter.md`; user guide: `docs/content/user/hydramp_execution.md`.
Preparation receipt `devguide/evidence/hydramp_execution_adapter_preparation.json`,
SHA-256 `fdb6474c203c591e6cff8921504d2bad9991b3aeadaadc088e1853cf6c8a6296`.

**Zero new real model/PCA/descriptor/Macrel calls so far.** No real authorization/model-attempt file exists. Previous allowances are exhausted; root AGENTS.md requires fresh exact-plan host/call approval. Broader dev3/H0–H4 disposition, historical numerical FAILs, unknown chemistry and joint AMP/hemolysis limits remain unchanged. No commit, push, public package/model release or site deployment; resources retained through 2026-11-13.
scope: Controlled adapter implementation and proposed real-case plan only; new scientific execution approval pending
